name: Tragedy of Medusa
source:
Three sisters who are goddesses decide to leave their island to visit Athens in the middle of a war waged by gods, demons and succubi. Survival ultimately becomes their goal as a faction of the gods known as the Olympians seek to destroy them.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186300/]Steam[/url]]
